description: This Java source file implements a data access object (DAO) for ProductAttribute entities, providing methods to retrieve product attribute data from the database using QueryDSL with JPQL queries. It extends a generic DAO implementation and is annotated as a Spring Repository.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for ProductAttribute entities, providing database retrieval methods for product attributes.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductAttribute entity by its unique ID, fetching related product, option, option value, and store information.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetches a list of ProductAttribute entities associated with a specific product option ID and store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Gets a list of ProductAttribute entities matching a list of attribute IDs for a specific store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves ProductAttribute entities associated with a specific option value ID and store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Fetches ProductAttribute entities related to a specific product, store, and language, including descriptions.
